entities.summary: Count Nikolay Semyonovich Mordvinov was a Russian political thinker of Alexander I's reign. He is associated with the reforms of Mikhail Speransky, who he advised on the ways to improve the performance of the national economy. Nikolay Mordvinov was a performers & entertainers from Saint Petersburg (1755-05-12, Saint Petersburg–1845-04-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
